changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Error') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [fusion].[Error]( [ExecutionID] [int] NOT NULL, [Date] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Error] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionError] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Date] ASC ) ) END
